root_cause.legacy_loader: Trims lines, doubles backslashes, expands environment references, then Properties.load; Java property escaping changes JDBC URL and credentials.
root_cause.fix: Typed private TOML environment plus documented whole-value !{...} literal resolver escape; explicit DEL/C1 Unicode escaping; semantic snapshot and distribution pin unchanged.
root_cause.credential_boundary: Reject NUL/invalid UTF-8 and CR/LF/NEL/LS/PS before subprocess launch; literal-value resolver cannot preserve those line terminators.
root_cause.secret_masking: Raw, URL, JSON, legacy property and exact TOML-encoded credential forms are redacted.
